newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung approached by two investors.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung approached by two investors.

text.p: Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd said on Monday two potential investors had presented preliminary proposals regarding a possible investment in the company.
"The proposals are in the process of being considered by the banks and the company and a further announcement will be made when progress has been made," it said in a statement.
New World Development Co Ltd said last month it had proposed to take a majority stake in the troubled company.

Siu-Fung Ceramics said last November it was having serious cashflow problems and was in discussions with its banks to identify immediate funding requirements and alternatives for restructuring its debt.
Trading in its shares has been suspended since last October.
